Brief review 2026-09-25 (BÄVER Taköverdraget för Husvagn) — this brief has an error the editor must know about:
1. Row 3 line `Överdraget stannar vid takkanten, hela vägen runt vagnen.` and the picture note `nothing hanging below it` contradict the product page: the edge hangs 30–40 cm down over the sides so the roof/wall seam is covered. Do not frame the edge away — show it hanging over the side, and use the alt line for row 3 (`Sidoväggen, fönstret och dörren syns hela varvet runt.`) or `Bara taket och kanten.`
Fix before production. If the ad is already live, apply it to the next version — nothing is paused. Status unchanged.
